fin.meta: Reached the net worth goal and came back to Start
fin.tiempo: Time is up: the highest net worth wins
sala.escanea: Scan the QR code or go to {direccion} and type the code.
sala.sin_red: To play with phones, open the board from the laptop server (node tools/serve.js).
sala.error: The room could not be opened: {motivo}
sala.sin_wifi: The laptop does not seem to be connected to any wifi: the phones will not be able to join.
jugador.codigo_ayuda: You can see it on the board screen, or scan its QR code.
jugador.conectando_lento: This is taking a while. Is your phone on the same wifi as the board?
jugador.sin_red: I can't find the board. Open this page from the address the board shows, with your phone on the same wifi.
jugador.sin_sala: There is no room with the code {codigo}.
jugador.empezada: The game has already started and you can't join halfway through.
jugador.ficha_al_azar: If you don't choose a token, you'll get a random one.
jugador.esperando_inicio: Waiting for the board to start the game…
jugador.error_red: Couldn't send that. Check your connection.
jugador.situacion.deuda_mia: You owe {acreedor} {cantidad:dinero}: sell or mortgage to pay.
jugador.situacion.deuda_banco: You owe the bank {cantidad:dinero}: sell or mortgage to pay.
jugador.situacion.deuda_ajena: {jugador} has to raise money to pay a debt.
jugador.situacion.mi_compra: You're on {casilla}: do you buy it?
jugador.situacion.mi_tirada: It's your turn: roll the dice.
jugador.situacion.mi_gestion: Manage your things or end your turn.
jugador.calles.vacio: You don't own any property yet. Buy one when you land on it.
jugador.calles.en_tu_turno: You can build, mortgage and sell on your turn.
jugador.calles.falta.uno: You need 1 more street in the district to build.
jugador.calles.falta.otros: You need {n} more streets in the district to build.
jugador.bolsa.sin_mercado: This game is played without the living market: there is no Stock Exchange.
jugador.bolsa.abierta: The Exchange is open: you can buy shares in packs of {n}.
jugador.bolsa.cerrada: The Exchange is closed: you can only buy shares when you pass Start or land on the Stock Exchange or the Brokerage.
jugador.tratos.vacio: No deals yet. Propose one to another player: streets, money, shares…
jugador.tratos.no_se_puede: It can't be accepted right now: something it includes is no longer available.
jugador.subasta.vas_ganando: You're winning: wait for someone to outbid you.
jugador.subasta.fuera: You dropped out: the auction goes on without you.
jugador.subasta.sin_dinero: You don't have enough money to bid more.
jugador.dock.quebrado: You went bankrupt. You can keep watching the game.
jugador.dock.no_alcanza: You don't have enough money to buy it.
sala.otras: If a phone can't get in, try another address: {direcciones}
panel.poner_bot: Let a bot play for {jugador} (if they step away)
